maria: Hey team — PR #4562 is blocked, CI failing on integration-kv (shard4). Can someone either rerun the shard or give a quick override? Logs pasted below. ci-bot: build #4562 failed: test_integration_kv_timeout on shard4 (flaky). See: https://ci.internal/builds/4562 maria: log snippet: ``` === FAIL: TestKVIntegration (0.73s) kv_test.go:120: expected "
ok
" but got "
ok
" --- FAIL: TestKVIntegration/InsertRace (0.04s) test_utils.go:45: timed out waiting for leader election ``` ryan: I can kick a targeted rerun for shard4 now. starting it. @maria @alex ryan: command I used: `/rerun --pr 4562 --shard shard4 --targeted` alex: thanks, ry. quick note — first failure looks like trailing whitespace in html snapshot, might be a snapshot drift. sophia: let's not update snapshots automatically. need to confirm reproducible. I can try to reproduce locally. maria: +1. If rerun passes once it's likely a flake. If it fails consistently we should dig in. low risk change but still want clean CI. :+1: ci-bot: targeted rerun queued (job 7890) — triggered by @ryan oncall: watching CI jobs; will escalate if this repeats 3+ times in the same window. ryan: rerun started (job 7890). ETA ~3m. jen: If it fails twice, can we consider merging with a temporary skip for that test behind a feature flag? what's the fallout? maria: backend behaviour is behind feature flag so functional risk is small. prefer to avoid skips unless we see a persistent pattern. ryan: job 7890 finished: PASS ✅ alex: nice — looks like transient. still suggest opening a tiny follow-up to trim whitespace in renderer later. sophia: reproduced the whitespace locally once after a reload race; filing a follow-up GH issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/issues/789 maria: cool. @alex @jen can one of you add a quick LGTM so I can merge? I'll wait 10m for objections. alex: lgtm. jen: approved. maria: thanks everyone — merging in 8m. I'll monitor CI for the next hour and revert if the flake returns. :shipit:
